label: GO step after an unrewarded trial when the agent picks a1 (late in episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (0 activations after a rewarded trial), and almost only when the agent itself chooses a1 (95% of mass at model_act==1; mass rises steeply with the a1-minus-a2 policy logit, 56% in the top choice bin). Strongly depends on episode position: zero before trial ~30, 96% of mass in trials 50-99, so the gate apparently drifts across the episode. Enriched when the good state is S1 and after rare transitions, but those conditions did not raise F1. GO & prev_reward==0 & model_act==1 alone gets mass recall 0.95 but precision 0.18; adding ep_trial>=50 gives precision 0.30, mass recall 0.91. Most matching steps stay below threshold, so the unit is a weak, graded signal (unrewarded-then-choose-a1, late in episode) whose magnitude carries the information. Adding value, choice-logit, or reward-two-trials-back conditions did not help. Uses no future variables: model_act is the agent own choice computed at GO.
